messages.subject: INLA Consulting contract
parts:
Hello, 

My company in Montreal is looking to hire a part-time contractor to help us with an INLA related R&D project. The candidate should have experience with Bayesian methods in general and INLA in particular. Knowledge/experience of network meta analysis is beneficial but not required. 

The position can be fully remote. If you are interested, please email me: kathryn AT precision-analytics.ca 

Thank you!
Kathryn
